newsitem.title: GREECE: IRAQ TO START $53 MLN DEBT REPAYMENT TO GREECE.
newsitem.headline: IRAQ TO START $53 MLN DEBT REPAYMENT TO GREECE.

text.p: Iraq has agreed to pay back a $ 53 million debt to the Greek state and the Greek Powder and Cartridge Company (Pyrkal), Defence Undersecretary Dimitris Apostolakis told parliament on Thursday.
Parliament sources confirmed that Apostolakis answered an opposition member's question on the issue and reassured Greek parliament members that an agreement between Greece and Iraq had been reached.

The payment will start with installments in kind, namely Iraq will provide Greece with crude oil and its derivative products in a first effort to repay its debt, the Athens News Agency (ANA) reported.
The remaining amount will be paid in cash after the embargo against Baghdad is lifted ANA said. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
